name: support-routing
description: Route an inbound customer support ticket to the team that should own it.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: Ticket subject line as written by the customer.

fields.name: channel
fields.description: Where the ticket arrived: email, chat, or web.

decision.instructions: Which team should own this support ticket? Judge by what the customer needs done, not by incidental words.

choices.label: billing
choices.description: Charges, refunds, invoices, receipts, payment methods, taxes, and plan changes for an existing paid subscription.
choices.criteria: Money already owed or paid on an existing subscription: charges, refunds, invoices, receipts, payment methods, tax, currency, or proration.

choices.label: technical
choices.description: Bugs, errors, outages, performance, integrations, and API behavior.
choices.criteria: Something in the product or API is broken, slow, erroring, or behaving unexpectedly, including integrations and SDKs.

choices.label: account
choices.description: Login, access, users, roles, workspace settings, profile changes, and personal-data requests.
choices.criteria: Identity and access: logins, passwords, 2FA, users, roles, ownership, workspace or profile settings, deletion, or data-privacy requests.

choices.label: sales
choices.description: Pricing questions, quotes, demos, trials, upgrades, discounts, contracts, and partnerships before or while buying.
choices.criteria: A purchasing conversation: pricing, quotes, demos, trial extensions, upgrades, discounts, contracts, procurement, or partnerships.
